recommendation: Enforcement of low complexity, limited size of components, and prohibition of dynamic memory allocation
description: For ASIL C and D, dynamic memory allocation at runtime is highly not recommended (--) or strictly prohibited due to unpredictable timing and failure risks.
key_mitigations: Use static memory pools with compile-time bounded size.
Prevent recursion and verify loop termination boundaries.
Implement defensive checks for pointer validity.

recommendation: Defensive programming and range checking of input and output signals
description: All external and inter-module parameters (e.g. sensor readings, CAN signals) must be verified against physical boundaries before consumption.
key_mitigations: Plausibility checks on voltage, current, temperature, and speed.
Safe state fallback upon invalid parameter detection.
